correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated all 60 even permutations, closure-generated all 59 A5 subgroups including endpoints, verified the proper orders 2:15,3:10,4:5,5:6,6:10,10:6,12:5, and all 57 vertices,131 inclusion edges,15 triangles. Every C2<V4 edge is a free face of exactly one C2<V4<A4 triangle, leaving a connected 57-vertex,116-edge graph; b1=60. Across all 120 S5 conjugations the exact fixed-face Lefschetz traces are 60 on identity, 6 on transpositions, 0 otherwise. These yield the listed 60-dimensional Specht multiplicities and a one-dimensional invariant. Orbit counts under both inner A5 and full S5 are (7,8,1); the one triangular orbit has a free (2,4)-edge orbit, and the connected residual graph has b1=1, giving ordinary S1 quotient. Exhaustive finite verification pertains exactly to A5, no extrapolation to other groups.
